snippet.title: How an Expert Captain Might Have Saved This Learjet
snippet.description:

snippet.title: 🌊Live Scanner and Day Trade Ideas, NO DELAY. Morning Gappers Momentum and Halt Scanner 11/09/2026
snippet.description:
Join our community of day traders as we stream our proprietary stock scanners live during Pre-Market, Market Hours, and After Hours. Get real-time insights and make informed trading decisions with our state-of-the-art tools. Our advanced scanners and screeners provide real-time data without delay, giving you trade ideas and the competitive edge you need for profitable day trading. 

Support our channel by tipping us: https://streamelements.com/zendoo/tip


ZenScanner overview. These tools are designed to highlight stocks showing notable movement, momentum, volatility or trading activity, helping traders quickly identify names that may deserve further chart analysis.

IMPORTANT: SCANNERS ARE NOT BUY OR SELL SIGNALS

A stock appearing on a scanner is only a prompt to examine its chart. Traders must perform their own price-action analysis, confirm that the setup matches a defined strategy and wait for an entry that meets that strategy’s rules.

A proper strategy should define the entry setup, stop-loss, profit target or exit method, and maximum acceptable loss **before the trade is entered**. Scanner activity should never replace analysis, risk management or disciplined execution.

---

📊 Summary of Scanner Columns: Aim for all columns to be green. When all columns are neon green, the stock has the highest potential to move higher. These are not trading advice but suggestive signals to evaluate with due diligence.

🔊 Audio cues: Bell: Every 5 minutes Female Voice: New stock is rising towards High of Day (From our Discord scanner). Male Voice: Stock experiencing a price surge (2-minute momentum) with increased volume.

---

SCANNERS

• MOMO HoD  
Displays stocks showing momentum as they move toward their High of Day (HoD).

• MOMO HoD Tiles (Discord)  
A visual representation of stocks moving toward HoD. Each tile’s vertical position maps the current price between Low of Day (bottom red line), VWAP (middle yellow line) and High of Day (top green line).

A blinking green dot appears when a stock is near or at HoD and triggers the female voice alert. A blinking blue chevron appears when a stock rises more than 5% within the latest rolling two-minute window and triggers the male voice alert. The chevron is linked to the 2min. Momo UP scanner.

• Events List  
Displays a chronological log of scanner voice alerts.

• 2min. Momo UP / DOWN  
Tick-based scanners measuring price movement over a rolling two-minute window.

UP displays stocks rising more than 3%. The male voice alert triggers above 5%.  
DOWN displays stocks falling more than 3%.

• Gap UP / DOWN  
Display the 25 stocks with the largest percentage gains or declines relative to the start of the current market segment:

Pre-market: previous trading day’s close  
Regular market hours: 9:30 a.m. opening price  
After-hours: 4:00 p.m. closing price

• Watchlist UP / DOWN  
Evaluate the day’s strongest or weakest performers and highlight stocks with the best proprietary movement-performance and potential score. UP focuses on upside candidates; DOWN focuses on downside candidates.

Display interpretation:  
• One or a few large tickers filling the frame: strongest candidates to focus on and analyze  
• One or a few tickers not filling the frame: best available movers, but with limited overall quality or potential  
• Many smaller tickers filling the frame: several similar candidates, with no clear consensus  
• Many smaller tickers not filling the frame: mostly noise, with no particularly strong candidate

---
PROPRIETARY COLUMNS

• ZenV  
Measures the slope and direction of VWAP.  
Green: VWAP trending upward  
Red: VWAP trending downward

• ZenP  
Estimates volatility potential. Scores above 2 generally indicate stronger potential. Higher scores also imply greater price movement and risk, requiring tighter risk management.

• AtrSprd  
Measures how much of the stock’s ATR-based volatility is represented by the bid-ask spread. It helps filter out stocks whose spread is excessive relative to their normal movement.

• AtrVwap  
Distance between the latest price and VWAP, expressed in ATR units.  
Green: above VWAP  
Red: below VWAP

• AtrHod  
Distance between the latest price and High of Day, expressed in ATR units. Green indicates the stock is less than one ATR away from HoD.

• 2min%  
Tick-based price change over the latest rolling two-minute window.

• ZenVR  
A proprietary short-term volume-activity metric used to filter out stocks with insufficient activity. It is similar to volume per second, with additional price weighting to better reflect the significance of the traded volume.

---

DISCLAIMER

Our content is for educational and entertainment purposes and reflects personal opinions, not financial advice. Always trade what you understand, perform your own analysis and never follow anyone’s opinion or a scanner blindly. Trading involves risk, and you are solely responsible for your decisions.

snippet.title: Tampil gemilang, Vozinha angkat trofi pertama di umur 40 th!
snippet.description:
Andai dijadikan film, kisah soal Vozinha mungkin aja jadi film yang laris untuk ditonton. Di usia 40 tahun, ia meraih trofi pertama dalam kariernya setelah melakukan penyelamatan krusial di akhir laga, dan apa yang terjadi kemudian sungguh mengharukan. Sebelum piala dunia, tak ada yang mengenal Vozinha, tapi setelahnya ia bisa masuk nominasi kiper terbaik di Ballon d'Or, duduk tepat di belakang superbintang seperti Mbappé dan Olise, bahkan sempat berfoto dengan Lamine Yamal. Sulit dibayangkan, puncak karir malah terjadi saat umurnya sudah 40 tahun. Nah sekarang, timnya yaitu Colo-Colo melakoni pertandingan penentu gelar juara Liga Chili dan Vozinha main sejak awal. Saat Colo-Colo sedang unggul 2-1, di menit ke-97, Vozinha melakukan penyelamatan krusial, untuk mempertahankan kemenangan Colo-Colo dan mengantar mereka juara Liga. Ini adalah trofi pertama bagi Vozinha, dan setelah ketemu nama-nama hebat di sepak bola, sekarang Vozinha bisa mengangkat piala bersanding dengan legenda terbesar Chile, Arturo Vidal.
